reviewDispositions.numericStarFlags: 15 raw flags: 10 actual item-price claims; 5 currency-conversion explanations are allowed by the current shared prompt and not classified as item-price bugs. Non-numeric unsupported estimates are additional observations, not included in the 10.
reviewDispositions.emptyReplyFlags: 4 raw flags: 3 acknowledged photo cards with captions removed; 1 deliberately rejected 403 send with recovery suppressed because permission was denied. The latter is expected, not a bot bug.
reviewDispositions.visibilityFlags: 22 broad heuristic flags; many are ordinary Telegram payment instructions. Do not count all 22 as bugs. Specific unverified visibility and invented resend restrictions remain documented observations.
reviewDispositions.V1RawFailures: 14 raw failed turns are not 14 confirmed bugs. Exclude 8 budget-boundary/later turns; investigate legacy offer-policy/transport fidelity before classifying missed-photo or offer-lookup outcomes. Five name-recall failures before the budget boundary produced missing-name or malformed text.
